_readme: This file holds everything edited in the admin panel (yoursite.com/?admin=1). It starts empty, which means the site uses the built-in defaults from src/data/site.js. When you press Publish in the admin panel, your browser downloads a new content.json — replace THIS file with that one, then push, and the live site updates. Keys left out here always fall back to the defaults, so a small file is normal.
